title: Animals that hatch from eggs
examples: Do all animals that lay eggs hatch from eggs?
What kind of animal hatches from an egg?

explain.say: Some animals start life inside an egg.
Birds lay eggs, and baby birds hatch from them.
Reptiles like snakes and lizards also hatch from eggs.
Fish lay eggs that float in the water. Tiny fish hatch from them.
Insects like butterflies and beetles hatch from eggs too.
In everyday life, think about a bird's nest holding eggs.

faq.q: Do all animals that lay eggs hatch from eggs?
faq.a: No, some animals give birth to live babies. Mammals are one example of this.

faq.q: Which group of animals hatches from eggs in water?
faq.a: Fish lay eggs that are usually laid in water. The babies hatch when the water conditions are right.

faq.q: Are insects the only things that hatch from eggs?
faq.a: No, birds, reptiles, and fish also have babies that hatch from eggs. Each group is different.

faq.q: How do birds care for their eggs before hatching?
faq.a: Birds often sit on the eggs to keep them warm. This warmth helps the baby bird grow inside.
asks: What do parents do to eggs?

faq.q: What is the difference between hatching and giving birth?
faq.a: Hatching means coming out of an egg. Giving birth means coming out of a mother's body.
asks: Is hatching the same as being born?
How do babies leave the egg?

facts: Birds build nests to lay their eggs safely.
Reptiles often lay eggs in dry places like nests.
Fish eggs are usually laid in water.
Insects undergo changes after hatching, like a caterpillar to a butterfly.

quiz.say: A baby bird coming out of an egg is called:
quiz.why: Hatching means the baby animal has broken out of the shell.

wrong.0: This word is too general; hatching is the specific term for eggs.
wrong.1: Growing is what happens over time, but hatching is the action of coming out.
wrong.3: This is wrong because giving birth happens from a mother's body, not an egg.

quiz.say: Which animal group lays eggs that float in water?
quiz.why: Fish lay their eggs into the water environment to keep them safe.

wrong.0: Reptiles usually lay eggs in nests on land or in burrows.
wrong.1: Insects lay eggs on plants or in soil, not usually floating in open water.
wrong.3: Birds usually lay eggs in dry nests on land.

quiz.say: If a caterpillar hatches from an egg, what is the next stage?
quiz.why: After hatching, many insects go through a pupa stage before becoming adults.

wrong.0: The adult stage comes after the pupa stage, not right away.
wrong.1: A cocoon is a wrapping, but the insect goes through a pupa inside it.
wrong.2: Larva is the stage before the pupa, like the caterpillar itself.
